title: Sheafification turns hypercovering conditions into surjections of F(K)
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Translate the hypercovering axioms into sheaf-surjectivity statements for the simplicial presheaf F(K): (1) is the covering K_0 -> {X->X} pushed through sites-lemma-covering-surjective-after-sheafification; (2) uses that cosk_0 sk_0 K has terms K_0 x K_0 so (d_0,d_1) : K_1 -> K_0 x K_0 is a covering, pushed through F which turns products into fibred products over h_X; (3) needs the identity cosk_n sk_n F(K) = F(cosk_n sk_n K) for n >= 1: prove it via the finite-limit-commuting functor F' : SR(C,X) -> PSh(C)/h_X (lemma-coprod-prod-SR), which gives cosk_n sk_n F'(K) = F'(cosk_n sk_n K), and the connectedness of (Delta/[m])_{<=n} for n >= 1 (categories-lemma-connected-limit-over-X), which identifies F'(cosk_n sk_n K) with cosk_n sk_n F(K); then (3) is F applied to the covering K_{n+1} -> (cosk_n sk_n K)_{n+1}.
